query: WITH expected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::uuid[], $3::text[]) t(field, id, name)), locked_genres AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT g.id, g.name FROM genres g JOIN expected e ON e.field = 'genres' AND g.id = e.id AND g.name = e.name ORDER BY g.id FOR SHARE OF g), locked_moods AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT g.id, g.name FROM moods g JOIN expected e ON e.field = 'moods' AND g.id = e.id AND g.name = e.name ORDER BY g.id FOR SHARE OF g), locked_tags AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT g.id, g.name FROM tags g JOIN expected e ON e.field = 'tags' AND g.id = e.id AND g.name = e.name ORDER BY g.id FOR SHARE OF g) SELECT 'genres' AS "field!", id AS "id!", name AS "name!" FROM locked_genres UNION ALL SELECT 'moods', id, name FROM locked_moods UNION ALL SELECT 'tags', id, name FROM locked_tags LIMIT $4
